audit_target: Direction C.4 Production Statistical Corrections and Regression Gate
verdict_rationale: Direct source inspection, transparent mathematical derivations, and regression tests confirm that trader-timemachine/benchmark_engine.py now contains the corrected Deflated Sharpe Ratio (DSR) dimensional scaling, the null-centered moving-block bootstrap hypothesis test, conventional arithmetic Sharpe ratio, and DSR sensitivity grid reporting. All 476 tests pass with zero failures and zero errors.

pre_correction_legacy_output.defect: Divided annualized Sharpe numerator by daily standard error, inflating z by sqrt(365.25)=19.11

edge_cases_handled: extreme moments (kurtosis=20, skewness=-2) properly widen se_sr
deflated_sharpe_ratio.api_compatibility: Preserved (returns float DSR by default, dict if return_details=True)

pre_correction_legacy_output.defect: Uncentered percentile inversion (fraction of replicates <= 0.0) rather than hypothesis test under H0

hypothesis_specification.alternative_hypothesis: H1: mu(D_t) > 0 (one-sided upper tail by default)

features_verified: Agreement with analytical Student t-test on independent series
AR(1) persistence (phi=0.50) expands variance (L=10 yields higher p-value than L=1)
Non-divisible sample size (N=698, L=10) handled via correct truncation
Deterministic execution using dedicated random.Random(seed) without global state pollution
Degenerate inputs (sample < block_size) return status SAMPLE_TOO_SHORT and p=1.0

conventions.return_type: Daily periodic arithmetic return (P_t - P_{t-1}) / P_{t-1}
conventions.rf_conversion: Linear daily rate conversion: rf_annual / annual_factor
conventions.degrees_of_freedom: Sample variance with N - 1 degrees of freedom

documentation_warnings: Historical effective trial count (M_eff) cannot be empirically reconstructed because aligned daily return series for V1-V3 do not exist.
Values such as M_eff in [15, 25] and sigma_trials = 0.50 are heuristic sensitivity assumptions, not measured facts.
A sensitivity grid does not resolve unknown research-selection bias or macro survivorship bias.
